body: Is that redirect route all that someone would need to reproduce this issue?
Thanks @BassemN I'll see what I can find.
Also `Router::getRequest()` returns `null` when I use it into app `routes.php`, in CakePHP 3.2, it was returning $request object.
I was able to reproduce this and will get a fix together.

@BassemN Yes, that will continue to not return a request until later in the dispatch cycle. If you need rely on that timing behaviour you will need to continue using the `RoutingFilter` and `ControllerFactoryFilter` instead of the `RoutingMiddleware`.

@markstory Thanks for your time.
Great and what about the redirect issue?
@BassemN I'll have a fix up for the redirect issue later today.

issue.title: Fix missing base directories in redirect routes.

repository.name: cakephp
repository.description: CakePHP: The Rapid Development Framework for PHP - Official Repository

issue.body:
Under the new PSR7 HTTP stack, redirect routes would be missing their base directory as Router did not have the correct context set. Instead of making the Router request stack PSR7 aware, I've made the request context data PSR7 aware by introducing a new public method. Longer term I'd like to remove the request stack entirely, as its requestAction() will also be leaving.

Refs #9470
